facts.fact: Mauritius's ICT minister Avinash Ramtohul told the National Assembly that draft amendments to the Cyber Security and Cybercrime Act 2021 have been prepared, covering deepfakes and harmful AI-generated content and providing for a Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Agency of Mauritius.
facts.system: Cyber Security and Cybercrime Act 2021 draft amendments

MUS.note: The document states no government use of AI.
The document states no AI in a sector's public system.
The document states no AI model, dataset or computing built in Mauritius.

facts.fact: Mauritius's ICT minister Avinash Ramtohul said proposed amendments to the Cyber Security and Cybercrime Act 2021 have been prepared, covering cyberharassment, doxxing, impersonation, fake profiles and disinformation, with platform duties and a new agency.

MUS.note: The document states no cut, punishment, repeal or criticism by a named body; it reports a minister's answer on a draft framework.
